description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any Raisely API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Pass the FULL API path after the base, starting with a slash, INCLUDING any query string, e.g. "/subscriptions/{uuid}/donations" or "/donations?limit=50". Returns the parsed JSON.

path.description: Full API path after the base, starting with "/", e.g. "/donations?limit=50".
